description: geolysis is a Python library for geotechnical analysis and modelling. The repository describes soil engineering calculations and points to documentation, an Excel add-in and a separate graphical interface. A user supplies geotechnical investigation or design values and selects a supported analysis; outputs are calculated soil and foundation measures for the selected site. The package has no fixed national geographic extent. Its README includes installation and usage routes, and GitHub metadata states the MIT licence for this repository. The separate Excel and GUI projects may have different deployment or terms; this draft covers the Python source only. A limitation is that empirical soil relations and input data must be checked for local applicability before they inform engineering decisions. geolysis can help parameterise foundations and earthworks in infrastructure models. The related catalogue OpenSees record is a different structural analysis program. No package or site measurements were downloaded.
